label: Immigration Contact Center: languages for human rights and unpaid wage reports
appliesTo: Foreign nationals reporting unpaid wages, violence or other rights violations through 1345
why: Language coverage is the practical difference between a right existing and a right being usable, and it is the kind of provision that expands quietly without anyone updating the guides. The dedicated reporting line is also recent — the Ministry of Justice created an immigrant rights team and a dedicated option on 1345 in June 2026 — so material written before then does not mention it at all.

history.source: Ministry of Justice — immigrant rights and interests team; 1345 Immigration Contact Center
history.note: Reached through option 1 on 1345, covering unpaid wages, assault, sexual violence and other rights violations, with referral to the relevant agencies. Separate from the Foreign Workers Support Center on 1577-0071, which serves Employment Permit System workers with multilingual counselling and three-way interpretation on employment permits, workplace changes and workplace grievances.
